## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] No fabricated facts, tools, or links — anything unverifiable is marked `[to verify]`
- [ ] No copy-pasted external text — summarized in my own words, with links to sources
- [ ] No real personal or customer data anywhere (examples, logs, screenshots)
- [ ] Links include access date and, where relevant, maintenance status
- [ ] Lab changes include a way to run/verify them (script, requirements, or container definition)
